donatingPane_desc1: I don't like the intrusive feel of ads in games, and I feel that having players pay for in-game boosts creates a bad impression in the community, as it makes the game feel like a freemium or pay-to-win game.
donatingPane_desc2: However, I like the matter of donations, because nothing forces you to donate, purely from people's goodwill. If you like this game and want more content faster, if I feel this game is worth investing in, I would gladly spend more time on it.
achievementPane_desc: Here you can view your realm rank and all achievements.
account_desc: Once connected, your achievement spirit messages will be sent to the server spirit archive during self-save, ranking with other players.
jingjiePane_desc: Here is the current player ranking. Simply register an account to participate; everything self-operates.
jingjiePane_nodata: Wait for the next self-save to view rankings.
helpPane_desc: This guide will take you from the beginning of the game to activating your first Legacy, helping you learn everything you need to know.
help1_desc1: The first thing you can do is start gathering spirit materials. Click the Spirit Materials tab at the top left of the screen to enter the spirit materials interface. You can click any spirit material to enter its operation interface, where you can manually gain spirit materials or forge spirit artifacts for self-production. While all spirit materials can be forged, it is recommended to prioritize Lingstone and Lingmu in the early game.
help2_desc1: To unlock technique research, you must first forge a Lingstone Collector, requiring 10 Lingstone and 5 Lingmu. This is the first step toward self-operation. The Techniques tab is where you set up Wudao Platforms to produce Wudao, and where you discover and research new techniques.
help2_desc2: The first technique you can research is 'Sumeru Mustard Seed', which allows you to forge Storage to expand the maximum holding of each spirit material. This becomes necessary when forging spirit artifacts costs over 50 spirit materials. You can also research 'Qi Gathering Art', opening a new world of Zhenqi production.
help3_desc1: Each spirit artifact in the game produces different amounts, which can make spirit material balance difficult, especially Zhenqi, Xuantan, and Lingmu, as they are consumed by other spirit artifacts. It is recommended to first decide which spirit material's spirit artifact to forge — in most cases Lingstone — then produce the Zhenqi needed for Qi Gathering Arrays. Don't upgrade everything to spirit artifacts at once, or you will face Zhenqi shortage (which is bad, as spirit artifacts cannot operate without Zhenqi). Accumulate Xuantan to forge more spirit artifacts, or enhance the number of Tuna Arts to address this issue.
help4_desc1: To unlock Mystic Realm exploration, you first need to forge a Sky Ship. This should be your first major goal. Forging a Sky Ship requires substantial spirit materials; you may need to use higher-tier spirit artifacts to obtain them in reasonable time. Secondly, launching the Sky Ship requires Lingmai, which can be refined in Lingmai Prospecting. These consume substantial Lingye and Xuantan. Once your Sky Ship is ready, press the Ascend button to unlock Mystic Realm exploration and new techniques.
settingsPane_desc: You can enable options to change the settings you want.
importExport_desc: Copy this content to a file so you can import it later. You can also create multiple 'saves' by storing separate instances.
hardReset_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone after reset.
aboutPane_desc: This game was made by Freddec as a remake of the original game by Sparticle999. Of course, I have Sparticle999's authorization. I made this game to improve my VueJS skills and learn about incremental games.
about1_desc1: These are all the relevant links outside the game.
about1_desc2: These are links to the original game.
zhenqiPane_desc: Zhenqi is the foundation of cultivation, produced through breathing arts, qi gathering arrays, and progressing to lingmai extraction and Tiandao qi refining.
zhenqiT1_desc: Uses Xuantan as spirit catalyst to produce steady Zhenqi supply through breathing techniques.
zhenqiT2_desc: The Qi Gathering Array requires no spirit catalyst, slowly absorbing Zhenqi from heaven and earth.
zhenqiT3_desc: Powered by Lingye, extracts the power of Lingmai to produce large amounts of Zhenqi.
zhenqiT4_desc: Harnesses Spirit Core Fission to produce massive amounts of Zhenqi.
zhenqiT5_desc: Uses molten lava as spirit catalyst. The extreme temperature allows for large Zhenqi production at once.
zhenqiT6_desc: Through Spirit Core Fusion, merges two light spiritons into one heavy spirit core, releasing Zhenqi as vast as the stars.
zhenqiCangPane_desc: You can contain up to 100,000 Zhenqi. Unlock Zhenqi Pools to expand this limit.
zhenqiS1_desc: The Celestial Lord said: 'There must be a place to contain qi!' And so these pools came into being.
zhenqiS2_desc: Mirror-structured Zhenqi Pools condense spiritual force fields upon the pool walls to contain Zhenqi, with greater capacity.
zhenqiS3_desc: Improved structure makes spiritual force field storage more efficient, forming structural deposits that allow storing more Zhenqi.
zhenqiS4_desc: This pool uses spirit-magnetic force to draw and maintain spiritons from surrounding objects, allowing Zhenqi to be stored outside the pool. When Zhenqi inside is depleted, external reserves can be called upon, accommodating far more Zhenqi than previous tiers.
zhenqiS5_desc: Using spirit insect arts, improve the cluster pools to near-spirit particle scale, causing spirit force fields to stack and overlap, exponentially enhancing the storable Zhenqi capacity.
zhenqiS6_desc: Using vacuum casting techniques, Zhenqi is sealed within the pool's vacuum, achieving unprecedented Zhenqi storage.
yuanshenPane_desc: Yuanshen is the fourth state of matter, used by Tier 4 Constructs and Grand Sect Arrays as an extreme energy source.
yuanshenT1_desc: The Nascent Soul Projection art blasts Zhenqi into Qingqi, transforming it into Yuanshen substance.
yuanshenT2_desc: This art blasts dense Zhenqi into Taiyi mist, converting it into Yuanshen.
yuanshenT3_desc: Bathed in Yuanshen, what could be impossible?
yuanshenT4_desc: The Deification Supreme Array is a massive array forged of Xuangang, channeling quasispirit realm power toward gaseous spirit realms, instantly converting spiritual qi into Yuanshen for collection.
yuanshenS1_desc: The Yuanshen Palace uses specially controlled vessels to contain Yuanshen, keeping it hot and contained.
yuanshenS2_desc: Specially designed Yuanshen Palaces use Hanbing and ventilation techniques, allowing more Yuanshen to condense without damage.
yuanshenS3_desc: Partial vacuum casting techniques isolate the vessel from Yuanshen, allowing further condensation due to vacuum's isolation strength.
tiandaoPane_desc: Tiandao Shards can only be refined from spiritual power purer than mortal arts, thus Yuanshen is essential for refining this precious spirit material.
tiandaoT1_desc: Build self-operating methods to collect Tiandao Shards without personal effort.
tiandaoT2_desc: Tiandao Shard Refining uses spirit-wires immersed in highly radiating Lingye to capture Tiandao Shards from the star domain. Requires Yuanshen to refine the shards into usable material.
tiandaoT3_desc: An ancient method of obtaining Tiandao Shards: firing high-energy spiriton beams into barren star domains, then collecting the fragments.
tiandaoT4_desc: No need to destroy the star domain — directly forge spirit clouds to create Tiandao Shards!
xuantanPane_desc: Xuantan is a Tier 2 spirit material, used by Breathing Arts as a catalyst to gather Zhenqi for the sect. It is forged from Lingmu through spirit-fire refinement.
xuantanT1_desc: Send all Lingmu here, purify Xuantan traces and refine them.
xuantanT2_desc: Burns Lingmu at extreme temperatures, yielding purer Xuantan than the refining method.
xuantanT3_desc: Melts Lingmu with earthfire, cooling to obtain relatively pure Xuantan. Residuals can be recycled.
xuantanT4_desc: This Yuanshen-driven furnace reaches extreme temperatures, refining Lingmu into nearly perfect pure Xuantan.
xuantanT5_desc: Who would have thought broken charcoal tips could produce so much Xuantan?
lingyePane_desc: Lingye is formed from spiritual qi condensing within earth veins, used to refine Tier 2 Spirit Artifacts.
lingyeT1_desc: Set up a minor Spirit-Drawing Array to gather Lingye from earth veins.
lingyeT2_desc: Lingye Springs far surpass Spirit-Drawing Arrays, able to well forth abundant Lingye, yet require Zhenqi as the catalyst.
lingyeT3_desc: Lingye Refining Fields are large open areas, usually located beneath Lingmai, where abundant Lingye can be found underground.
lingyeT4_desc: The Lingye Furnace is a massive structure floating above the Ling Sea, extracting Lingye from the sea floor.
lingyeT5_desc: Far superior to its predecessors, this array reverses the fossil cycle — instead of burning, it creates Lingye from the air.
lingstonePane_desc: Lingstone is the foundational substance of cultivation, widely used in all manner of construction and refinement.
lingstoneT1_desc: Forge a Spirit Pickaxe to gather Lingstone with spiritual force.
lingstoneT2_desc: Lingstone Spirit Veins can draw forth Lingstone on a grand scale.
lingstoneT3_desc: Spirit Gathering Arrays draw forth Lingstone at astonishing rates.
lingstoneT4_desc: Lingstone Furnaces twist time and space, drawing forth Lingstone at rates beyond physical limits.
lingstoneT5_desc: Mines Lingstone from parallel worlds rich in Lingstone.
baoshiPane_desc: Meteorite Iron is a superior spirit material, used to refine high-tier Spirit Artifacts and powerful implements. Growing ever more vital as cultivation deepens.
baoshiT1_desc: Forge an improved Spirit Pickaxe to gather Meteorite Iron with spiritual force.
baoshiT2_desc: Meteorite Iron Veins can gather Meteorite Iron on a large scale. Due to spirit drill hardness requirements, the rate is slower than Lingstone Veins.
baoshiT3_desc: Iron Condensing Art is one of the strongest spirit drill arts in the spirit realm, thus the rate of gathering Meteorite Iron surpasses all before.
baoshiT4_desc: Carbyne Spirit Drill is one of the strongest spirit drill arts in the spirit realm, thus the rate of gathering Meteorite Iron surpasses all before.
baoshiT5_desc: This special spirit artifact condenses spiritual qi into Meteorite Iron, faster in rate than any spirit drill.
lingmuPane_desc: Lingmu is a common spirit material, more frequently used for implements and construction in the early stages of cultivation.
lingmuT1_desc: Forge a Spirit Axe to gather Lingmu with spiritual force.
lingmuT2_desc: Lingmu Spirit Gardens use spiritual power to drive artifacts gathering Lingmu, with efficacy far exceeding manual labor.
lingmuT3_desc: Ten Thousand Wood Art accelerates Lingmu growth; though it consumes Lingmai, the production is astonishing.
lingmuT4_desc: Lingmu Acceleration compresses waste materials into Lingmu, turning refuse into treasure.
lingmuT5_desc: The Ten-Thousand Wood Array gathers spiritual energy from heaven and earth to grow Lingmu endlessly.
yunjinPane_desc: Yunjin is essential for Tier 3 Spirit Artifact arrays, greatly aiding the construction of your first Legacy. Though a higher-tier spirit material, it is mainly obtained by spirit-fire refinement of Lingsha in the mortal realm.
yunjinT1_desc: This method instantly transforms Lingsha into Yunjin, but at limited scale. Refining requires off-world spirit materials.
yunjinT2_desc: This method uses spirit-fire to refine the coastline, drawing forth Yunjin on a grand scale.
yunjinT3_desc: This large-scale destructive method has been renamed and now hovers above the coastline — or rather, what remains of it.
yunjinT4_desc: This massive array encircles the earth, focusing on the wasteland, tearing Lingsha from the ground and transforming it into Yunjin under extreme heat.
yunjinT5_desc: This array harnesses the power of distant stars, heating Ling Sand into Yunjin at record rates.
leilingPane_desc: Leiling can be used for Zhenqi production, as Spirit Core Fission releases vast amounts of Zhenqi. Thus, it holds an important position in many higher-tier Spirit Artifacts and spirit propulsion techniques. However, Leiling is exceedingly difficult to obtain, requiring great quantities of spirit materials to withstand the harm of spiritual radiation.
leilingT1_desc: Shatter Leiling spirit ore to transport it from deep wells.
leilingT2_desc: This spirit tower uses teleportation arts to shift underground spirit rock to the surface, making Leiling easier to draw forth.
leilingT3_desc: Leiling Summoning improves Leiling quality, allowing more Leiling to be utilized.
leilingT4_desc: Recycle used Leiling, giving it a second use. Greatly enhances available Leiling per second.
leilingT5_desc: This massive array is as vast as a spirit realm, fusing Leiling from common spirit elements via spirit core fusion.
huoyanPane_desc: Huoyan's fierce nature is hard to tame, found only deep within volcanoes, and is one of the hardest spirit materials to draw forth.
huoyanT1_desc: Use a refined spirit cauldron to scoop Huoyan and seal it for later use.
huoyanT2_desc: Self-operates to swiftly draw forth Huoyan from volcanoes.
huoyanT3_desc: Rather than going out to find Huoyan, it's more convenient to create it yourself using heat and pressure.
huoyanT4_desc: A furnace of agony, pouring Huoyan from ore.
huoyanT5_desc: Condenses the spiritual energy from the Suixing Realm's core into lava.
yueshiPane_desc: Yueshi is found in the Yuejing Realm, a rare spirit material unseen in the mortal world. Stronger than Lingstone, yet harder to draw forth.
yueshiT1_desc: Dispatch spirit servants of the Yuejing Realm to gather Yueshi for you.
yueshiT2_desc: These spirit drill implements hover in the air, as if suspended in the void!
yueshiT3_desc: This mine tears the Yuejing Realm's surface, visible from the earth.
yueshiT4_desc: This large construct digs deep into the earth, searching for abundant Yueshi near the core. Lingstone originally came from deep underground.
yueshiT5_desc: Still wondering why there are so many moons in the sky?
miasmaPane_desc: Miasma is abundant on the Taibai Realm, and can channel spiritual power to the sect more efficiently than spirit materials.
miasmaT1_desc: Draw forth Miasma while purifying the spirit realm with spiritual force!
miasmaT3_desc: These spirit beasts have been modified to continuously produce Miasma.
miasmaT4_desc: Collects spiritual energy from the Zhenxing Realm's spirit satellite's ocean floor Lingmai.
miasmaT5_desc: A spirit beast spanning star domains.
xuangangPane_desc: Xuangang is chiefly found on the Yinghuo Realm, used to forge sturdy Spirit Artifacts and Miasma arrays.
xuangangT1_desc: Dispatch spirit seekers across the Yinghuo Realm's surface to find Xuangang revealed by wind and sand.
xuangangT2_desc: These Yueshi spirit drill implements are extremely powerful, drawing forth Xuangang from the Yinghuo Realm's earth veins.
xuangangT3_desc: This spirit artifact has been modified with five spirit drills on its front. Greatly enhances spirit material acquisition per second.
xuangangT4_desc: This mighty spirit drill is said to be wielded by ancient giants themselves.
xuangangT5_desc: You strike me down, but I shall not fall. I am Xuangang.
jinshaPane_desc: Jinsha resides within star domains, used to forge Legacies and intricate Spirit Artifacts.
jinshaT1_desc: Miasma-driven mechanical beasts seek out Jinsha spirit veins across the star domain.
jinshaT2_desc: Spirit drills into star domains to seek Jinsha. More efficient than simple mechanical beasts.
jinshaT3_desc: That's no moon! That's a Spirit Platform! This method slices open the star domain, exposing Jinsha within.
jinshaT4_desc: Accelerates time through spiriton techniques to produce more Jinsha.
jinshaT5_desc: Refining has advanced to the point where air can be transformed into Jinsha!
yinshaPane_desc: Yinsha is another spirit material commonly found in star domains.
yinshaT1_desc: Scout Sky Ships seek out Yinsha fragments embedded in star fragments across the star domain.
yinshaT2_desc: Fractures star domains to seek Yinsha spirit veins within the spirit core.
yinshaT3_desc: This large spirit drill construct, named after the giant cannon from a war a thousand years ago, is specifically designed for mining Yinsha from star domains.
yinshaT4_desc: This powerful array circles the Haiwang Realm, breaking down the star domain's surface to reveal Yinsha within.
yinshaT5_desc: Silver bullets used for hunting demon beasts are made from Yinsha compressed a thousand times over. Extracting them will benefit your production.
qingqiPane_desc: Qingqi is extremely common on qi-abundant realms like the Suixing Realm and Zhenxing Realm.
qingqiT1_desc: This Spirit-Drawing Array circles the Suixing Realm, drawing forth Qingqi and carrying it back.
qingqiT2_desc: The Gathering Array draws forth Qingqi with spirit-magnetic power, enhancing the gathering rate per second.
qingqiT3_desc: These are manufactured in the mortal realm, capable of converting water into Qingqi with sustained Zhenqi supply.
qingqiT4_desc: For some reason, it just works.
qingqiT5_desc: 'Steal' is too heavy a word. We prefer 'borrowed without return' — when we gather from the periphery of the stars.
taiyiPane_desc: Taiyi is the second most common spirit element on qi-abundant realms like the Suixing Realm and Zhenxing Realm.
taiyiT1_desc: Taiyi Condensation scouts Taiyi-rich areas on the Zhenxing Realm, then slowly draws it forth.
taiyiT2_desc: This massive spirit vessel holds large amounts of Taiyi, sent back from the Zhenxing Realm to the earth through the void.
taiyiT3_desc: The refiner densely compresses Taiyi into a small space for easy transport back to earth.
taiyiT4_desc: Flying spirit buckets into the atmosphere of a gaseous spirit realm — this is our best plan!
taiyiT5_desc: A controlled miniature celestial source uses Spirit Core Fusion to produce massive amounts of Taiyi.
hanbingPane_desc: Hanbing can be refined in the mortal realm, but traveling to the Mingxing Realm and returning fully loaded is far more rewarding. Primarily used for the extreme-cold spirit arts required by Tier 4 spirit artifacts.
hanbingT1_desc: Hanbing Condensation is the simplest way to draw forth frozen water — lowest spirit cost, but also slowest.
hanbingT2_desc: The Hanbing Condensation Array is more efficient than basic condensation, drawing forth more Hanbing per second. Yet requires Zhenqi as the catalyst.
hanbingT3_desc: With advanced techniques, you can now convert mortal water into high-quality Hanbing, previously only available from the Mingxing Realm.
hanbingT4_desc: This construct is the coolest guy in the spirit realm.
hanbingT5_desc: Extracting heat from spirit materials at extreme rates; you are unsure how to handle it safely, but you did it anyway.
wudaoPane_desc: Wudao is used to research new techniques, advancing your cultivation progress.
wudaoT1_desc: Build a small Scripture Pavilion to start producing Wudao. Each produces 0.1 Wudao/sec.
wudaoT2_desc: Set up more efficient Wudao Platforms to explore the Wudao Domain at a swifter rate. Each produces 1 Wudao/s.
wudaoT3_desc: Build higher-tier Wudao Platforms to further explore the realm of Dao. Each produces 10 Wudao/sec.
wudaoT4_desc: Create an Observatory, gazing at the stars to gain knowledge of the Great Dao.
wudaoT5_desc: Beyond the mortal dust, without atmospheric obstruction, comprehending the Dao of Heaven and Earth is far more efficient.
gongfaPane_desc: Research new techniques to unlock more mechanics and advance your cultivation progress.
techCangku_desc: Allows you to forge Storage upgrades, expanding the maximum holding of spirit materials.
techZhenqi1_desc: You will be able to burn Xuantan in a furnace to produce Zhenqi.
techLingye_desc: Lingye is used to power more advanced Constructs and can also produce more Zhenqi than basic methods. Unlocking the Path of Lingye allows you to extract Lingye from underground.
techZhenqi2_desc: Qi Gathering Arrays produce Zhenqi without spirit catalyst, but slower than other Zhenqi production methods.
techJinglian_desc: Refined Spirit Artifacts produce more spirit materials than simple methods, but require sustained Zhenqi infusion.
techSuimie_desc: Allows you to dismantle constructed Spirit Artifacts. Useful when you have more efficient spirit material gathering methods or insufficient Zhenqi to sustain the artifacts.
techLingmai1_desc: Unlocks Lingmai exploration, allowing Sky Ship departures and opening an entirely new field of techniques.
techLingmai2_desc: Lingmai Development is a more efficient method of Lingmai refining.
techLingmai3_desc: The Lingmai Grand Array is an array refined with Miasma that accelerates Lingmai production.
techWudao2_desc: Researching this technique will greatly increase Wudao production.
techWudao3_desc: Comprehending this technique will unlock Tier 3 Wudao refinement, far surpassing the previous tier.
techWudao4_desc: Comprehending this technique will unlock Tier 4 Wudao refinement, yielding ten times the output of the previous tier.
techZhenqiCang1_desc: The Zhenqi Pool Art increases the amount of Zhenqi you can hold at once.
techZhenqiCang2_desc: Zhenqi Pool Advancement increases the amount of Zhenqi you can hold at once.
techZhenqiCang3_desc: Zhenqi Pool Mid Tier increases the amount of Zhenqi you can hold at once.
techZhenqiCang4_desc: Zhenqi Pool High Tier increases the amount of Zhenqi you can store at once.
techYuanshen1_desc: Allows you to convert Zhenqi and Qingqi into Yuanshen.
techYuanshen2_desc: This research unlocks Tier 2 Yuanshen production — Deity Transformation Art.
techYuanshenCang1_desc: Yuanshen Halls expand the maximum Yuanshen you can store at once.
techYuanshenCang2_desc: Upgraded Yuanshen Halls store Yuanshen more efficiently but are larger, requiring more spirit materials to forge.
techWuhua1_desc: This technique not only lets you create existing spirit materials but also allows you to refine new spirit elements obtainable only through transformation, such as Tiandao Shards.
techTiandao0_desc: Tiandao Shards are among the rarest spirit materials in the star domain, artificially refined. All Tiandao Shards that once existed in the star domain have been gathered; now they can only be refined from Zhenqi in spirit artifacts.
techTiandao1_desc: Research self-operating methods for collecting Tiandao Shards without personal effort.
techTiandao2_desc: Research more efficient methods than manual refining for obtaining Tiandao Shards.
techDafazhen1_desc: The Sect Grand Array deploys arrays around the celestial source, producing large amounts of Zhenqi.
techDafazhen2_desc: The Sect Grand Array uses array rings around the celestial source, while the Completed Array fully envelops the celestial source, granting you enough Zhenqi to traverse star domains.
techChongqun1_desc: Imagine a plague of locusts, but worse. These spirit insects double the production of one spirit material for every ten! At the cost of rare Xuantan-based spirit materials, we gladly offer the diagrams of this exquisite art.
upgradeJinglian_desc: Make your spirit artifacts produce more spirit materials. This advancement doubles the spirit material refined per unit of Zhenqi.
upgradeZhenqi1_desc: After advancing Tuna Art, each produces 4 Zhenqi per second instead of 2.
upgradeZhenqi2_desc: After advancing Qi Gathering Array, each produces 3 Zhenqi per second instead of 1.5.
boostChanwu_desc: Production Boost enhances spirit material income by 1%/s per level.
boostWudao_desc: Wudao Boost enhances Wudao production by 2% per level.
boostZhenqi_desc: Zhenqi Boost reduces Zhenqi consumption of all spirit artifacts by 1%/s per level.
boostZhenqiCang_desc: Zhenqi Storage Boost enhances Zhenqi Pool capacity by 1% per level.
mijingRukouPane_desc: Forging a Sky Ship will allow exploration of Mystic Realms and gathering of spirit materials in the Spirit Realm.
mijingRukou1_desc: To ascend on a Sky Ship into the Mystic Realm, you must first complete its forging.
mijingRukou2_desc: Ascending on the Sky Ship into the Mystic Realm will unlock Spirit Realm spirit gathering, exploration, and other star domains. This requires Spirit Wings for navigation assistance.
lingmaiPane_desc: Lingmai is refined through Lingmai Prospecting, used for Sky Ship ascension and travel to other Mystic Realms and star domains.
lingmaiT1_desc: Lingmai Prospecting self-operates to refine Lingmai.
lingmaiT2_desc: Lingmai Development refines Lingmai faster and more efficiently than Prospecting.
lingmaiT3_desc: The Lingmai Grand Array accelerates Lingmai refining using greenhouse gases like Miasma.
yuejing_desc: The Yuejing Realm is our largest spirit satellite, circling the earth every 27 days. It contains abundant Yueshi, originating from its separation from the earth in ancient times. Yueshi is stronger than Lingstone and is used to forge higher-tier Spirit Artifacts.
chenxing_desc: The Chenxing Realm is a barren, lifeless spirit realm with little of value to offer. Setting foot upon it yields no benefit, for no precious spirit materials can be found there.
taibai_desc: The Taibai Realm is the most scorching spirit realm in the Spirit World and the closest to the earth. It is filled with fiery toxic qi, making it unbearably hot. You can draw forth Miasma from the Taibai Realm to open new paths of Zhenqi production.
yinghuo_desc: The Yinghuo Realm is the second closest spirit realm to the earth, its surface veiled in crimson iron spirit dust. You may find Xuangang upon it, yet the depths of its crust hold far greater abundance. Xuangang will allow the forging of Miasma arrays and Yunjin production.
xingchen_desc: The Xingchen Realm is a vast star domain with nearly 2 million star fragments scattered within. There you may more easily draw forth spirit metals rare in the mortal world, such as Jinsha and Yinsha.
mijingStation_desc: The Tiandao Mystic Realm is a grand and mysterious spirit construct. What lies within is not known to mortals, yet inscriptions on ancient artifacts depict something akin to it. It is said that within, you shall meet a near-transcendent Celestial Lord who reigns over the star domain. He is said to bestow many teachings upon you as you traverse the star domain.
suixing_desc: To forge a Spirit Platform within the Suixing Realm's qi to draw forth Qingqi would be an excellent choice!
zhenxing_desc: We have found a treasure trove! At least so it may be called. The Zhenxing Realm is the second largest spirit realm in the Spirit World, second only to the Suixing Realm. It is one of the few with spirit rings, and its qi is the most rarefied. You may find Taiyi here.
tianwang_desc: This spirit realm turns in a manner unlike others, with spirit winds reaching speeds of three hundred li per hour. Its spiritual elements are similar to the Zhenxing and Suixing Realms, consisting mainly of Qingqi and Taiyi. Thus it is not worth exploring for the same spirit materials as the Zhenxing and Suixing Realms.
haiwang_desc: The Haiwang Realm possesses the most bizarre celestial phenomena in the Spirit World. Massive spirit storms and wild winds far surpass those elsewhere in the Spirit World. There is naught there but Miasma, Qingqi, and Taiyi.
mingxing_desc: Hanbing, Hanbing! To refine great quantities of Hanbing in the mortal realm is exceedingly costly — drawing it forth from the Mingxing Realm is far more economical!
zaohuaRukou0_desc: Vast emptiness separates solitary rocks, drifting in three-hundred-year celestial orbits around the Heavenly Yang. Yet something of great importance lies hidden here, awaiting one of destiny to discover.
zaohuaRukou1_desc: Welcome to our clan's grotto-heaven. We are dedicated to cultivation advancement and take joy in forming bonds with other clans. If you are willing to trade with us, we shall offer technique diagrams rarely seen in the star domain.
mijingStationPane_desc: As you step into the spirit towers spinning in the void, you feel the Sky Ship drawn by a faint force toward the entrance on the lowest side. Disembarking onto the spirit field, you walk toward the grand hall ahead. Four massive murals hang upon the walls, depicting magnificent spirit constructs from all directions, with inscriptions below. At the far end of the hall stands a great door, tightly sealed with no sign of opening. You sense a supreme being watching as you cross the hall. Note: You must forge Legacies before activating them to gain their effects.
mijingBaoshi0_desc: The first mural depicts a massive spirit construct radiating spiritual light. The inscription reads: 'Though my wealth is unparalleled, I still cherish adding rare spirit materials to my collection. At the cost of your Meteorite Iron, Yinsha, and Jinsha, I shall teach you the secrets of the earth beneath your feet, enabling you to discover rare spirit materials and dangerous spirit elements never before seen.'
mijingLingmu0_desc: A pulsating image depicts a massive spirit tower with spiritual light flickering within. What does the Celestial Lord want this time? 'Having depleted the spiritual power of many star fragments, I desire a spirit construct to commemorate the spiritual power I seized from the star domain. In return, I shall grant you a method of spiritual power production that no one has ever been able to harness.'
mijingYunjin0_desc: An emerald scroll depicts the interior of a certain array formation. 'With my technique advantage in the star domain, I desire a monument to the advanced arrays I command. As a reward, I shall teach you the art of array spirit artifacts, enabling you to forge higher-tier spirit material gathering artifacts.'
mijingTiandao0_desc: A fiery red portrait depicts a set of cultivation spirit artifacts. 'You have accomplished much, yet now you must forge a legacy construct. As the next monument, I shall grant you a spirit artifact that exists only in legends. Tiandao Shard artifacts use Zhenqi as a conduit to convert Yuanshen into raw power for gathering spirit materials.'
mijingBaoshi1_desc: The Celestial Lord is pleased with the newly gained wealth, granting you the method to forge Spirit Wings, which circle the heavens and earth and can discover new spirit materials. Activating this Legacy will teach you about Leiling — how to obtain and harness it. Understanding this rare spirit element hidden deep beneath the earth will unlock Spirit Core Zhenqi, an entirely new path of Zhenqi production.
mijingLingmu1_desc: Now possessing the Spiritual Power Tower, the Celestial Lord grants you techniques for partial Zhenqi production. Activating this Legacy will allow you to harness Huoyan power, an entirely new path of Zhenqi production.
mijingYunjin1_desc: The Celestial Lord is proud of the new monument, teaching you array spirit artifacts and the path of advanced spirit material gathering. Activating this Legacy will allow you to forge Tier 3 spirit artifacts, a more efficient method of spirit material gathering.
mijingTiandao1_desc: The Celestial Lord observes the newly forged Legacy, granting you a new wave of spirit artifact power surpassing the past. Activating this Legacy enables you to forge Tier 4 spirit material gathering artifacts, more powerful and efficient than any before.
mijingChuansong_desc: In the center of the room, you see a charred resonance dish lying on the ground. The inscription beside it reads 'My original resonance array between my first two star domains.' A booming voice sounds again from the resonance array in the corner: 'This is one of my most cherished mementos, reminding me of the first message I sent between star domains. If you can repair it for me, I will help you conquer the stars.' Rebuilding the Resonance Legacy will allow you to communicate with races in other star domains and determine if intelligent life exists.
mijingFeizhou_desc: On the second floor, you find a chaotic scene of broken Constructs and scattered parts. You can reassemble what appears to be a Sky Ship Spirit Pivot nearby. The Celestial Lord's booming voice comes from the room's resonance array: 'Greetings, friend. As you can see, this floor is largely in disrepair. If you can fix it, you'll be well rewarded. Your first task is to repair the Legacy on the right. It was once a Sky Ship Spirit Pivot, but I'm not sure where the parts are. You may need extra research to rebuild it, but I believe you can manage.' Rebuilding the Sky Ship Legacy will grant you advanced techniques, teaching you how to fly beyond your small star domain.
mijingFangun_desc: In the corner of the floor, you see a large, faintly glowing container leaning against the wall. Pressing the red button next to it plays an announcement: 'This is the first Revenant Jar I used on my maiden star domain voyage. To repair it and recall my memories, I will teach you the art of Revenant refining, helping you fly beyond this world.' Rebuilding the Revenant Legacy will grant you Revenant refining and storage abilities.
mijingChuansongMen_desc: A massive frame resembling obsidian stands in the room, mounted on the far wall. The inscription reads: 'This is the passage to the third and topmost floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm. Activating it requires substantial spirit materials, but once complete, it will grant you access to the Hall of the Celestial Gate — the only way to leave this small star domain and explore beyond.' Activating the Portal will allow you to pass through to the third floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm, separated from the main spirit tower.
tiandiFazhenPane_desc: The final floor, though smallest in area, appears to be a treasure room, displaying majestic control consoles and a large table.
mijingXingmen_desc: After rebuilding the Heaven-Earth Array Immortal Gate, you will be able to explore beyond your star domain.
techYuanshen0_desc: Yuanshen is a state of extreme spiritual power, usable as vast energy storage and enabling higher-tier Constructs and conversions.
techWuhua0_desc: Five Elements Transformation is an art that mortals only dare dream of. Here, it has become reality. You can convert Zhenqi and Yuanshen into common spirit materials, or with substantial investment into rare spirit materials — those you cannot find and can only obtain through refining.
techDafazhen0_desc: This technique was unheard of before, now made possible by the ancestors of the Forge of Creation. The Sect Grand Array can provide massive Zhenqi for millions of years, but at what cost? Note: Array Segment consumption is based on how many you own, so it resets when depleted or decreases when partially consumed.
wuhuaPane_desc: Five Elements Transformation is an art that mortals only dare dream of. Here, it has become reality. You can convert Zhenqi and Yuanshen into common spirit materials, or with substantial investment into rare spirit materials — those you cannot find and can only obtain through refining.
dafazhenPane_desc: This technique was unheard of before, now made possible by the ancestors of the Forge of Creation. The Sect Grand Array can provide massive Zhenqi for millions of years, but at what cost? Note: Array Segment consumption is based on how many you own, so it resets when depleted or decreases when partially consumed.
lingzhenDuan_desc: These massive arrays cannot be built all at once. You must start with small segments, forged around the celestial source.
dafazhenT1_desc: The Ring is an array belt circling the celestial source, producing 5,000 Zhenqi/sec. A total of 50,000 Lingmai is needed to deploy Array Segments.
dafazhenT2_desc: The Cluster is an array formation circling the celestial source, producing 25,000 Zhenqi/sec once built. However, it requires 250,000 Lingmai to deploy Array Segments.
dafazhenT3_desc: The Completed Array is a grand array that fully envelops the celestial source. It will provide enough Zhenqi for star domain travel, eventually leaving this star domain. It produces 1,000,000 Zhenqi/sec.
chongqun_desc: Imagine a plague of locusts, but worse. These spirit insects double your production for every ten! They can replicate the form of other spirit artifacts and take on their roles. You can choose one spirit material to boost, and change at any time.
lingyinPane_desc: Here you can learn about other star domains to explore. Note: The first star, Alpha Centauri, is 4.3 light-years away. One Spirit Resonance Array cannot reach it.
lingyinT1_desc: The theoretical problem of star domain travel is about to be overcome. Use this advancement to solve it. This is a one-time advancement that expands your exploration range by 5 light-years.
lingyinT2_desc: The Celestial Lord grants you the technique of using Spirit Resonance Arrays to discover star domains beyond. Each array adds 1 light-year of exploration range.
feizhouPane_desc: Here you can forge Sky Ships to travel to the stars.
feizhou_desc: The Sky Ship can travel to stars in the star domain but cannot land on celestial bodies within the domain.
huti_desc: This array protects against celestial source radiation, keeping those aboard safe from the void's cold.
dunfa_desc: These Spirit Pivots combine Revenant and matter in controlled spiritual reactions, generating spirit propulsion to send you toward the stars.
lingyi_desc: Spirit Wings allow Sky Ships to easily enter and exit atmospheres without worrying about air resistance.
fangunPane_desc: The spirit catalyst for your star domain travel is refined here. Unfortunately, each Mystic Realm can only process 100,000 Revenant due to its extreme instability.
fangunT1_desc: This powerful array can convert high-energy Yuanshen into the most efficient spirit catalyst we can imagine.
diziT1_desc: Outer Disciples are the smallest and fastest, costing the least. Though seemingly insignificant, their numbers can be deadly in battle.
diziT2_desc: Stronger than outer disciples, inner disciples are medium combatants. Stronger attack, but notably slow agility.
diziT3_desc: Spirit Core Disciples are medium disciples, with decent agility among other attributes. Slightly weaker defense, but attack and agility make up for it, a good choice to fill the disciple team.
diziT4_desc: Elders are expensive investments, but reward with balanced attack, defense, and agility. They are high-end disciples, both in attributes and cost.
diziT5_desc: Sect Masters are defensive-heavy disciples, yet can still deal heavy blows with powerful attacks. The main drawback is slow agility, hampering the team's mobility.
chiyanMijingPane_desc: The Chiyan Sect is a fierce sect with strong hatred toward those in power — especially the Biluo Sect. They persistently fight back with all-out attacks. Thus, their enhancements mainly favor more active playstyles.
biluoMijingPane_desc: The Biluo Sect is the ruling power in the star domain, most dedicated to maintaining the status quo. Opposing change, they practice authoritarian rule, mainly offering enhancements regarding Defensive Grand Arrays and Legacies.
zixiaoMijingPane_desc: The Zixiao Sect is a cultivation-loving sect, proud of all technique progress and always looking to the future. They fight for truth and welcome anyone who shares their beliefs.
jinguangMijingPane_desc: The Jinguang Sect grows ever stronger in the star domain, driven by profit, allying with those who support their goals. Their enhancements focus on passive benefits, with numerous self-operating functions.
xuanmingMijingPane_desc: The Xuanming Sect is an expansion-focused sect, aiming to conquer star domains. They often play both sides in conflicts, hoping to profit from the chaos. They provide travel improvements, including Sky Ship construction and star domain travel.
tiandaoLawPane_desc1: We've arrived, seemingly at the end of the journey, but you don't realize... this is only the beginning. Looking up at the stars, you ponder how to use your newly acquired wealth and the sects in the Spirit Realm.
tiandaoLawPane_desc2: Suddenly, the Celestial Lord speaks to you: 'You have cultivated for a long time, and I sense your life is approaching its end after years of sect management. Yet, you haven't achieved what I expected.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc3: 'Though I'm disappointed that you haven't reached the greatness I expected, out of your loyalty and devotion to me, I am prepared to give you another chance at life.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc4: 'You will have many opportunities to satisfy me, for when you feel the time is right and need to make a sacrifice, I will grant you the power of Ascension. Your sect will be stronger after each Ascension, and as long as you remain loyal to me, I will guide you in conquering the star domain.'
tiandaoLawPane_desc5: 'You will start anew, a new life, but at the cost of your soul. I will reward your next life with the Dao you've learned in this world and one of the most precious materials in this realm — Tiandao Law.'
tiandaoLaw_desc: Here you can see how much Tiandao Law you've obtained and what you'll gain upon Ascension.
dmWonders_desc: You earn Tiandao Law for completing each floor of the Tiandao Mystic Realm. You may have already achieved all of these before your first Ascension. Each floor completion grants 4 Tiandao Law, but the final floor only grants 2 (only one Legacy).
dmSpheres_desc: Building a Completed Array in your local star domain grants 15 Tiandao Law. Each one built in other star domains grants 5 Tiandao Law.
dmResearches_desc: Every 25 levels of repeatable technique research efficacy grants 2 Tiandao Laws.
dmRank_desc: Reaching each achievement realm grants 2 Tiandao Law. Since the first few achievement realms are easy, this will be the main source of Tiandao Law early in each Ascension.
dmSwarms_desc: One of the more esoteric systems: Tiandao Laws from spirit insect swarms are calculated using an ancient number sequence: triangular numbers. You gain 1 Tiandao Law when passing each triangular number of spirit insect swarms. For example: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, 21...
rebirth_desc: Stepping into new life is a great decision, not to be taken lightly. Once confirmed, you can start anew, preserving the knowledge and experience of your past life, reborn and transcending the past. You will retain all unused Tiandao Laws and your enhancements. Taking this step is a leap not just for this life, but for every ascension. Once activated, you will no longer feel so weak. Note: Even the second ascension requires a completed Grand Array. Note: You will retain all enhancements purchased in your past life.
rebirth_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone after reset and save.
chiyanChuanchengPane_desc: The Chiyan Sect is a fierce sect with strong hatred toward those in power — especially the Biluo Sect. They persistently fight back with all-out attacks. Thus, their enhancements mainly favor more active playstyles.
upgradeLingqu_desc: Increases all gain buttons from 1 to 20 per click. Increases relationship by 3.
upgradeCangku1_desc: At the start of each ascension, the maximum storage for all spirit materials is 6,400. (No effect if already above 6,400). Enhance relations by 6 points.
upgradeCangku2_desc: All Storage no longer consumes 100% of primary spirit material, but 75%. Enhance relations by 14 points.
techZhenqiCang6_desc: Unlocks Vacuum Zhenqi Pool. Increases relationship by 15.
upgradeCangku3_desc: Opens a rift in multidimensional space, allowing you to store spirit materials in other dimensions, exceeding default capacity by up to 10x, with production reduced 95% after overflow. Enhance relations by 26 points.
biluoChuanchengPane_desc: The Biluo Sect is the ruling power in the star domain, most dedicated to maintaining the status quo. Opposing change, they practice authoritarian rule, mainly offering enhancements regarding Defensive Grand Arrays and Legacies.
techYuanshen3_desc: Unlocks Deity Transformation Array. Increases relationship by 4.
upgradeMijing1_desc: All Legacy activation costs in the Blessed Realm reduced by 15%. Increases relationship by 10.
upgradeMijing2_desc: All Legacy activation costs in the Immortal Citadel Core and Heaven-Earth Array reduced by 20%. Increases relationship by 15.
upgradeMijing3_desc: Dongtian Fudi Legacy self-preforges each ascension. Still needs activation. Enhance relations by 11 points.
techYuanshen4_desc: Unlocks Deity Transformation Apex Array. Increases relationship by 17.
techYuanshenCang3_desc: Unlocks partial vacuum casting Yuanshen Palace. Increases relationship by 12.
autoWuhua_desc: Once activated on a Five Elements spirit material, that spirit material will self-convert at the spirit frequency. Enhance relations by 17 points.
zixiaoChuanchengPane_desc: The Zixiao Sect is a cultivation-loving sect, proud of all technique progress and always looking to the future. They fight for truth and welcome anyone who shares their beliefs.
upgradeWudao1_desc: Each Ascension starts with 20 Tier 1 Wudao Platforms. Increases relationship by 3.
upgradeWudao2_desc: Tier 2 and above Wudao Platform costs reduced by 20%. Increases relationship by 12.
techWudao5_desc: Unlocks Wudao Platform Apex. Increases relationship by 14.
upgradeZhenqiBoost_desc: Raises Zhenqi Boost research cap from 25% to 50%. Increases relationship by 25.
jinguangChuanchengPane_desc: The Jinguang Sect grows ever stronger in the star domain, driven by profit, allying with those who support their goals. Their enhancements focus on passive benefits, with numerous self-operating functions.
upgradeTier1_desc: Spirit cost for Tier 1 spirit artifacts of all spirit materials (in spirit materials tab) is reduced by 10%. Enhance relations by 4 points.
techZhenqiCang5_desc: Unlocks the fifth tier Zhenqi Pool for all your Zhenqi storage needs. Increases relationship by 17.
multiBuy_desc: Unlocks the power of batch building and dismantling! Increases relationship by 20.
boostLingyun_desc: For each spirit material that reaches storage capacity, all other spirit materials gain 5% production bonus. Enhance relations by 18 points.
techTier5_desc: Gain research access to Tier 5 spirit material spirit artifacts. These unlock after activating the Tier 4 Tiandao Legacy. Enhance relations by 20 points.
xuanmingChuanchengPane_desc: The Xuanming Sect is an expansion-focused sect, aiming to conquer star domains. They often play both sides in conflicts, hoping to profit from the chaos. They provide travel improvements, including Sky Ship construction and star domain travel.
upgradeLingmai1_desc: Lingmai Prospecting (Tier 1) Lingmai production enhanced by 100%. Enhance relations by 7 points.
upgradeDizi_desc: Sky Ship component costs reduced by 35%. Increases relationship by 28.
techTiandao3_desc: Unlocks Tiandao Shard Condensation building. Increases relationship by 29.
techTiandao4_desc: Unlocks Tiandao Shard Furnace building. Increases relationship by 36.
tiandaoChuanchengPane_desc: This sect is shrouded in mystery. Though not well understood, a powerful force overlooks the entire star domain, seemingly above the other five sects and their 'trivial' disputes. Enhancements from the Celestial Lord you serve are not constrained by type, varying greatly.
boostTiandaoLaw_desc: Each unused Tiandao Law enhances all spirit materials (including Wudao) by 1%. Enhance relations by 20 points.
techChongqun0_desc: Imagine a plague of locusts, but worse. These spirit insects double your production for every ten! They can replicate the form of other spirit artifacts and take on their roles. You can choose one spirit material to boost, and change at any time. Note: Appears in the Furnace of Creation after unlocking. Enhance relations by 17 points.
upgradeZongmen_desc: All sect relations enhanced by 20. Enhance relations by 20 points.
toastAchievement_text: You have achieved a new milestone.
toastAutoSave_text: Your save spiritual data has been stored locally in your browser.
toastSpySuccess_text: You successfully spied on the Mystic Realm's defenses.
toastSpyFailed_text: All your Outer Disciples were lost.
toastInvadeSuccess_text: You successfully invaded the Mystic Realm, gaining production bonuses.
toastInvadeFailed_text: The enemy was too powerful. All your disciples perished.
toastAbsorbSuccess_text: You peacefully absorbed the Mystic Realm, gaining production bonuses.
spy_desc: Here you can send disciples to gather intelligence on enemy disciple fleets. At the first level, you can see the number of digits in enemy stats. The second level reveals the first digit of all three stats, and each subsequent level reveals the next digit.
invade_desc: Here you can activate disciples and attempt to invade the sect's Mystic Realm. Your relationship with them affects their readiness. The Mystic Realm's stats account for this. Invasion negatively impacts your relationship with that sect — successful invasion reduces relationship by 10. However, due to their arrogance, failed attempts are deemed unworthy of note, so relationship remains unchanged.
absorb_desc: Absorption is the easiest way to conquer a Mystic Realm. Unfortunately, you must maintain a good relationship with the controlling sect — relationship above 60 is required to absorb. You lose 5 relationship points upon absorption, half that of invasion.
